run_relaxation_calculations: run atomic structure relaxation calculations on a sequence of molecules using an ASE calculator
create_relaxation_runner: create a RelaxationRunner instance with an ASE calculator and AtomsSequence input data for relaxation
save_relaxation_checkpoint: save the current relaxation progress to a checkpoint directory for preemption recovery
load_relaxation_checkpoint: load previously saved relaxation progress from a checkpoint directory to resume interrupted runs
write_relaxation_results: write relaxation calculation results to a compressed JSON file in the results directory
